abstract: Fetus in fetu is a rare condition that has been defined as the presence of one of the twins in the body of the other. It is most frequently located in retroperitoneal area; however, it has been reported in other locations as well. This report presents two cases of "fetus in fetu" cases: one located in the retroperitoneal area and the other in the sacrococcygeal area.
abstract_ja: 胎児内胎児は、双胎の一方が他方の体内に存在する稀な状態と定義される。最も多くは後腹膜に存在するが、他の部位でも報告されている。本報告では後腹膜および仙尾部に存在した「胎児内胎児」の2症例を提示する。
